dayLines: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s telling A person, maybe 30s about himself. The retelling is already better than the event.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose telling A woman, maybe 20s about A man, maybe 60s. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
💧 A woman, maybe 20s returns with water: +4 clean.
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ A woman, maybe 20s catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with restless hands returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A man, maybe 40s, with restless hands settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with restless hands.)
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
A man, maybe 50s is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 73/100)
Giulia and Felicia lingered over the fire together.
Thabo and Rosa lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Crude bow at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Flannel Shirt at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.

— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 the man in his 60s, the chef starts a story with "back when I was a Chef..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 60s).
A woman, maybe 30s, with a wiry build will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.

A woman, maybe 20s doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
📋 A person, maybe 30s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)

Something moves out there — a toad like a war drum, throat swelling.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
Movement — a bobcat, tufted ears, watching you with yellow eyes.
👁 It is hunting you. Don't run — that invites the chase. Hold your ground, strike true, or wear the claws.
You see smoke on the horizon. Emberhold — 11 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
